address: via di Porta Soprana 55 r, Genoa, 16123, Italy
bio: Just a stone's throw from the alleged home of Christopher Columbus and Piazza De Ferrari, you will find cosy rooms and lounges, as well as a handy outdoor area in the pedestrian zone. Here, the expert hand of the Scala family, which also runs the renowned San Giorgio, will make you appreciate market and regional cuisine, especially seafood. You will often find the famous Genoese cappon magro, but there is no shortage of good meat-based alternatives, revisited in a slightly contemporary key and carefully plated. It will be easy to find a good match, even by the glass, thanks to a fine selection of wines....
